from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,itertools,time
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/home/administrator/substrate-222/proposals/P256-qed-backward')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
import induced_phi_em_full_current_inserted_response as r
own=Path(__file__).read_bytes();start=time.monotonic()
path=ROOT/'induced_phi_em_full_current_inserted_response_actual_receipt.json'
raw=path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='f57776ebcad02fe5818d42ed906cd3b625f50d45559d34ad9c2c253a1dff4d35'
receipt=json.loads(raw)
for name,entry in receipt['source_at_import'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(r.SOURCE_BYTES[name]).hexdigest()==entry['sha256'],name
_,inserted=r.checked(receipt['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['inserted'])
_,force=r.checked(inserted['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['force'])
_,current=r.checked(force['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['current'])
_,retarded=r.checked(current['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['retarded'])
_,field=r.checked(retarded['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['clock'])
_,bridge=r.checked(field['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['bridge'])
_,mean=r.checked(bridge['input_descriptor']['input_receipts']['mean'])
native=r.build_native(mean,6);B,frame=r.spin_basis(native)
sites,V=native['sites'],native['V']
momenta=np.array([[x,1,0] for x in (0,2,4)])
plane=np.exp(1j*sites@(2*np.pi*(momenta+.5)/6).T)/np.sqrt(V)
orbital=np.einsum('xa,st->xsat',plane,np.eye(4)).reshape(4*V,12)
Bfull=np.kron(np.eye(3),B)
pp=np.array([4*x+s for x in range(3) for s in (0,1)]);nn=pp+2
masks=tuple(sum(1<<i for i in inds) for inds in itertools.combinations(range(12),6))
lookup={mask:i for i,mask in enumerate(masks)}
occupations=[[i for i in range(12) if mask&(1<<i)] for mask in masks]
f=np.cos(4*np.pi*sites[:,0]/6)*np.sqrt(2/V)
S=np.array([[1,1],[1j,-1j]],complex)/np.sqrt(2)
rows=[]
for profile in native['Pprofiles']:
    h=orbital.conj().T@profile['hcentre']@orbital
    assert np.linalg.norm(profile['hcentre']@orbital-orbital@h)<1e-9
    assert np.linalg.norm(h-h.conj().T)<1e-10
    hb=Bfull.conj().T@h@Bfull
    K=-1j*hb[np.ix_(pp,nn)]
    mass=float(np.trace(B[:,:2].conj().T@profile['onsite']@B[:,:2]).real/2)
    Y=K/(2*mass+native['UE']/native['a'])
    assert np.linalg.norm(Y-Y.conj().T)<1e-10
    R=np.linalg.inv(np.eye(6)+Y@Y)
    ev,vec=np.linalg.eigh(R);rootR=(vec*np.sqrt(ev))@vec.conj().T
    W=np.empty((12,6),complex);W[pp]=-1j*Y@rootR;W[nn]=rootR;W=Bfull@W
    psi=np.array([np.linalg.det(W[inds]) for inds in occupations])
    assert abs(np.vdot(psi,psi)-1)<1e-10
    Js=[]
    for axis in (1,2):
        direction=np.zeros(3*V);direction[axis::3]=f
        fullJ=r.path_derivative(native,profile,np.zeros(3*V),direction,1)
        j=orbital.conj().T@fullJ@orbital
        assert np.linalg.norm(fullJ@orbital-orbital@j)<1e-9
        assert np.linalg.norm(j-j.conj().T)<1e-10
        Js.append(j)
    sourceJs=[sum(S[b,a]*Js[b] for b in range(2)) for a in range(2)]
    act=lambda a,v:r.sector_action(a,v,masks,lookup)
    Xi=[act(j,psi) for j in sourceJs]
    sourceGram=np.column_stack(Xi).conj().T@np.column_stack(Xi)
    hpsi=act(h,psi);energy=np.vdot(psi,hpsi)
    nonstationarity=float(np.linalg.norm(hpsi-energy*psi))
    assert nonstationarity>1e-4
    eps,vec=np.linalg.eigh(h)
    times=[]
    for t in (0.,.013,.125):
        u=(vec*np.exp(-1j*t*eps))@vec.conj().T
        Wt=u@W
        psit=np.array([np.linalg.det(Wt[inds]) for inds in occupations])
        sourceBack=[u@j@u.conj().T for j in sourceJs]
        probeBack=[u@j@u.conj().T for j in Js]
        sourceTime=[act(j,psit) for j in sourceBack]
        left=np.column_stack([act(Js[i],sourceTime[a]) for a in range(2) for i in range(2)])
        right=np.column_stack([act(probeBack[j],sourceTime[b]) for b in range(2) for j in range(2)])
        F=left.conj().T@right
        G=F.conj().T.reshape(2,2,2,2).transpose(0,3,2,1).reshape(4,4)
        tensor=-1j*(F-G)
        direct=np.empty((4,4),complex)
        for a in range(2):
            for i in range(2):
                late=u.conj().T@Js[i]@u
                for b in range(2):
                    for j in range(2):
                        comm=late@Js[j]-Js[j]@late
                        direct[2*a+i,2*b+j]=-1j*np.vdot(Xi[a],act(comm,Xi[b]))
        defect=float(np.linalg.norm(tensor-direct,2))
        wrong=-1j*(F-F.conj())
        wrongDefect=float(np.linalg.norm(wrong-direct,2))
        assert defect<1e-9,(profile['load'],t,defect)
        eg,vg=np.linalg.eigh(sourceGram)
        assert min(eg)>0
        whitening=np.kron((vg*(1/np.sqrt(eg)))@vg.conj().T,np.eye(2))
        times.append(dict(time=t,exact_nonstationary_retarded_tensor_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(direct,2)),packed_partial_transpose_error=defect,wrong_entrywise_conjugation_error=wrongDefect,source_Gram_whitened_wrong_entrywise_error=float(np.linalg.norm(whitening@(wrong-direct)@whitening,2)),ordered_F_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(F,2)),source_evolution_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(psit))))
    assert max(x['wrong_entrywise_conjugation_error'] for x in times)>1e-8
    rows.append(dict(load=int(profile['load']),closed_orbit_momenta=momenta.tolist(),all_spin_modes=12,filled_particles=6,full_retained_CAR_dimension=len(masks),source_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(psi)),actual_source_non_eigenstate_residual=nonstationarity,source_Gram_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(sourceGram).tolist(),times=times))
